articles.title: Killeen Mayor Pro Tem Jessica Gonzalez Steamrolls to Victory in Bell County JP Race
articles.excerpt: Gonzalez won the Nov. 3, 2026 election for Justice of the Peace, Precinct 4, Place 2, which covers much of Killeen and Harker Heights, according to unofficial returns (Bell County Elections; Killeen Daily Herald).

articles.title: Gonzalez, a Killeen councilwoman, wins Democratic JP primary runoff
articles.excerpt: She won the May 26, 2026 Democratic runoff over LaTasha Quarles, 1,233 votes (51.3%) to 1,171 (48.7%), in final unofficial results (Killeen Daily Herald).

articles.title: JP for Killeen Quarles Gonzalez Head to Runoff Election as Incumbent Finishes 3rd
Recall Petition Submitted for Mayor Pro Tem Gonzalez Awaits Verification
articles.excerpt: Background: Gonzalez has served on the Killeen City Council since 2021 (KDH), representing District 1 in north Killeen (KDH), and is the city's mayor pro tem.

articles.title: Cox and Gonzalez Participate in Justice of the Peace Forum ahead of Nov Election
articles.excerpt: At an Oct. 7, 2026 candidate forum hosted by the Herald, she said her work as a property manager, including eviction proceedings, has prepared her for the office, cited the mandatory 80-hour state training for new judges, and said she would step down from the council if elected (KDH).

articles.title: Here S a Rundown of Area Election Results from Tuesday Night
articles.excerpt: Gonzalez won the race for Justice of the Peace, Precinct 4, Place 2 with 31,485 votes (62.9%); opponent: Beatrice "Bea" Cox (R) 18,588 (37.1%), in unofficial returns (Bell County Elections; Killeen Daily Herald; Killeen Daily Herald).
